items.method: Cross-read the single-name options tape (call-versus-put premium, call fraction, and the composition and side of the heaviest same-session prints) against the cash-market internals (market-heatmap breadth versus its 60% threshold) and the options-structure corridor (negative dealer gamma, flip, put and call walls, expected move), then judge whether a shift from call-led to put-led premium under narrowing breadth is genuine hedging demand rather than noise, and anchor a direction-correct invalidation to the gamma-flip level above spot whose reclaim would falsify the caution.
items.note: The genuinely new signature this window is a rotation in the derivative tape from uniformly bullish to two-sided and put-led. Single-name option premium is now balanced at a 0.594 call fraction — $1.545B of call premium against $1.056B of put premium across 12 tickers with 1446 contracts clearing the $250k bar inside 30 days — a clear step down from the call-heavy lean carried earlier. More telling is the composition of the heaviest prints: the single most unusual is a same-session TSLA 345 put at $22.7M on 57.4x open interest, and the second is a same-session SPY 765 put at $44.5M struck exactly on the put wall, so the largest premium is now being paid for downside protection rather than upside chase. This lands on a cash tape that is still narrow — market-heatmap breadth is 44.42% of 134 constituents positive, a 15.58-point miss of the 60% broad-participation line — and a mechanically fragile options structure: SPY is in negative dealer gamma with spot near 765.46 wedged between the 765 put wall and the 770 call wall, about 1.6 points under the 767.08 flip, inside a plus-or-minus 7.39 expected move, while the intraday auction is a Range day pinned to a 765.56 VWAP. Put-led premium concentrating at the put wall under narrowing breadth in negative gamma is a caution read on the index. Watch a sustained loss of the 765 put wall as the confirming trigger that accelerates the move down; the caution is invalidated on a daily close above ~767.08 on SPY, which reclaims the gamma flip, flips dealers positive and releases the corridor upward.
items.title: The single-name options tape has flipped from one-sided call demand to a two-sided, put-led tape this window — flow is balanced at a 0.594 call fraction ($1.545B calls vs $1.056B puts across 12 names) and the single most unusual print is now a same-session TSLA 345 put at $22.7M on 57.4x open interest, printed alongside a $44.5M SPY 765 put, while SPY sits in negative dealer gamma below the 767.08 flip between the 765 put wall and the 770 call wall

items.method: Cross-read three independent internals — the sector RRG rotation states and accelerations, the real-assets 0-100 composite leadership across crypto, broad commodity and the monetary metals, and the market-heatmap breadth versus its 60% threshold — to test whether a risk-on leadership rotation is firming against the narrow breadth, then, finding no direction-correct price level on a single committed-universe instrument that expresses the cluster, withhold a tactical call rather than publish one that cannot be scored.
items.note: The new cross-model pattern this window is a risk-on rotation cluster that sits in tension with, rather than alongside, the narrow cash breadth. The sector model has rotated its leadership into communications — XLC is Leading with acceleration +5.42 and healthcare XLV is a Leading co-leader at +2.56 — while financials XLF weakens and rotates out, a shift away from the defensive staples-and-healthcare tilt carried in the prior window. The real-assets model reinforces the risk-on read: crypto leads with ETH-USD at 76.7/100, bitcoin (BTC-USD) at 69.6 and IBIT at 61.9 all in uptrends, and broad commodities are firm with PDBC 65.5 and DBC 62.1, while the defensive monetary metals lag — gold (GLD) reads 49.6 with six-month momentum of -10.99% and silver (SLV) is weak at 22.7. Communications and crypto leadership with firm broad commodities is a coherent speculative-appetite signature that argues against reading the narrow 44.42% breadth as uniformly defensive. This is a structural observation, not a scoreable trade: the cluster does not resolve to a single committed-universe instrument with a direction-correct price level this window — the sector reads are relative-strength and rotation states, the real-assets reads are 0-100 composite scores, and neither is a price trigger — so a tactical call is withheld rather than published with only a working side. Watch whether breadth reclaims the 60% participation line to confirm the risk-on rotation, or whether XLC leadership fades back toward defensives; until an instrument-level price trigger is in view, the cluster is carried as counter-weight evidence to the index-level caution, not as its own call.
items.title: A risk-on rotation cluster is firming underneath the narrow breadth this window — sector leadership has turned into communications (XLC Leading, accel +5.42) out of financials (XLF Weakening), and real assets lead with crypto (ETH-USD 76.7, BTC-USD 69.6, IBIT 61.9) and firm broad commodities (PDBC 65.5, DBC 62.1) while gold (GLD 49.6, six-month momentum -10.99%) and silver (SLV 22.7) lag — a cross-model tension with the 44.42% breadth read that resolves to no single committed-universe price level
